name: Holo1.5-7B
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct (config.json max_position_embeddings 128000). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-27. A finetune of Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct, not a new base model: same config.json, same 8.292 parameters (identical tensor set). Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2025-09-11. SECOND-TABLE COMPLETION 2026-11-01: the card prints TWO tables - UI localization and UI question answering - and only the localization table had been ingested. Added the QA table's four rows for this model (VisualWebBench 82.60, WebSRC 95.90, ScreenQAShort 91.00, ScreenQAComplex 83.20) with the Qwen2.5-VL-7B base column (69.00/95.00/87.00/81.10) printed beside them. WebSRC is a +0.9 tie and ScreenQAShort a +4.0 win, so the QA surface is a much thinner gain than the localization surface - the card's '3.9% over SOTA' headline is the QA average, not this model's localization margin.
